jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative, French or German Speaker (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll play an important role in helping our existing customers scale while managing requests and closing deals from a large book of accounts. You’ll build a strong foundation of knowledge across our product platform and internal sales processes while partnering with Support, Order Management, and Marketing. You’ll also gain experience qualifying and routing inbound prospects to an aligned Account Executive. Ultimately, this experience will help you serve customers efficiently and support your own career development in Sales. As a founding member of this new team, you're adaptable and eager to contribute to how the strategy of this function evolves over time.

This is a full time role that can be held from our London hub.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Communicate with existing customer accounts through email, Zoom, and Ironclad about Figma’s platform and pricing 
  • Close inbound sales requests for subscription expansions, including adding products or licenses, creating new instances, and upgrading to the Enterprise Plan
  • Manage inbound billing requests (such as processing renewals and changing payment term/method) 
  • Close targeted outbound account renewals 
  • Qualify and handle inbound sales requests 
  • Partner with Marketing to run proactive campaigns that maximize expansion/retention across all products 

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Desire to build career in Sales - ultimately working towards Senior Inside Sales Representative and Account Executive roles at Figma 
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to learn new products, processes, and policies as we go 
  • Collaboration across multiple teams (such as Sales, Support, Billing, and Marketing)
  • Inherent curiosity and commitment to ongoing learning, adaptable and comfortable navigating frequent change, and high achiever with a strong inner motivation to over-achieve
  • Fluent in French or German language

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • B2B SaaS experience 
  • Customer-facing Sales/Support experience 

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status

jobs.title: Customer Enablement Manager, French Speaking (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Enablement Manager, you’ll work directly with some of our largest customers to help them get the most value from the Figma platform. You'll design and deliver tailored enablement strategies that drive product adoption, help uncover new use cases, and support long-term success.

In this highly collaborative role, you’ll partner with various internal teams such as Account Executives, Onboarding Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Industry Advocates to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.to deliver thoughtful, engaging experiences for our customers. Your ability to build strong relationships, connect the dots between product features and customer goals, and communicate with clarity will make you a trusted advisor and strategic partner.

If you’re passionate about helping customers thrive, enjoy solving complex problems, and love working at the intersection of product and customer success, we’d love to meet you.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage the adoption journey for a portfolio of large, strategic customers, aligning engagement with customer goals and success metrics
  • Use product data and customer insights to develop proactive engagement strategies that drive measurable value
  • Document engagement strategies through high-quality, bespoke enablement plans tailored to each customer
  • Share best practices, use cases, and product expertise to help teams unlock the full value of Figma
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across roles and departments, from individual contributors to senior leaders
  • Identify and empower internal champions who can advocate for Figma and drive adoption within their organizations
  • Collaborate with Account Executives on account reviews, expansion opportunities, renewal risk mitigation, and overall account strategy
  • Deliver live and scalable training tailored to customer maturity and needs, partnering cross-functionally with Onboarding Managers, Technical Account Managers, Solutions Consultants, and Industry Advocates to ensure customer success

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Technical Customer Success, Customer Success, Customer Enablement, Account Management or a relevant customer-facing role in SaaS
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to connect with a wide range of customer personas
  • Strong product knowledge and a customer-first, consultative approach to solving challenges and driving adoption
  • A track record of driving impactful outcomes, adapting to evolving customer needs, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Fluency in French, additional European languages a plus

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience using Figma or working with design and collaboration tools

jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $100M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
As a Staff Product Designer, you’ll be the first designer in our London office, taking on some of our most complex product challenges and setting a high bar for design quality across products and teams.
You’ll partner closely with product and engineering to shape direction, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, and deliver best-in-class interaction and visual design. This is a highly hands-on role for a designer who can move between product strategy and craft, and whose work raises the quality of the team around them.
What you’ll do
Lead design across multiple product areas, creating coherence across complex workflows and experiences.
Shape product strategy: frame the hardest problems, influence roadmaps, and turn ambiguity into bold, practical solutions.
Set and raise the bar for design craft, accessibility, and usability across Legora’s product.
Partner with product and engineering to make smart tradeoffs that protect the experience while shipping quickly.
Explore new product directions, from zero-to-one concepts to scaled launches.
Explore and implement new ways of working with AI to produce better design outcomes, faster.
Help make Legora a destination for exceptional design talent in London.
About you
Extensive product design experience with a track record of shipping complex, high-impact products.
Exceptional craft in interaction and visual design, with the ability to connect the details to the bigger picture.
Comfortable owning complex, ambiguous problems and creating clarity across teams and product areas.
Skilled at moving seamlessly between hands-on design and product strategy.
Strong product judgment and communication skills; you influence direction and inspire confidence across product, engineering, and leadership.
What’s in it for you
Career development opportunities in a rapidly evolving entrepreneurial environment.
Direct collaboration with senior leadership and the opportunity to impact company growth and strategy.
A collaborative, high-energy team where your ideas and contributions are valued and implemented.
Competitive salary complemented by a transparent and highly competitive options program.
Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer
At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law

jobs.title: VP, EMEA Sales
jobs.description_text:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a VP, EMEA Sales to lead and scale our regional sales organization as we enter a period of high growth and expand across a growing portfolio of products. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this leader will own new business and expansion revenue across EMEA’s Enterprise and Corporate segments.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a builder and operator who can turn regional insight into a focused go-to-market strategy, build a repeatable pipeline engine, and create the operating discipline needed for predictable growth. The VP will lead a multi-level sales organization and partner closely with Marketing, SDR/BDR, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Partnerships, Enablement, and Revenue Operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Own EMEA new business and expansion revenue across Enterprise and Corporate segments.
  • Set regional go-to-market strategy across segmentation, territories, coverage, capacity, hiring, and resources.
  • Build repeatable pipeline across outbound, inbound, account-based, and partner channels.
  • Establish operating rhythms for pipeline inspection, forecasting, deal progression, performance, and business reviews.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts and visibility into pipeline, deal health, productivity, risks, and opportunities.
  • Lead and develop Sales Directors, Managers, and Account Executives while building a strong management bench.
  • Drive consistent sales methodology, account planning, qualification, and pipeline hygiene.
  • Engage in strategic deals through executive relationships, value selling, negotiation, and deal strategy.
  • Scale land-and-expand across new logo, adoption, cross-sell, and expansion motions.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Customer Success to improve deal quality, adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Align with Marketing and SDR/BDR leadership on campaigns, account priorities, lead follow-up, and pipeline goals.
  • Build co-sell and partner motions that extend regional reach and generate qualified pipeline.
  • Represent EMEA in global go-to-market planning and bring regional insight to company strategy, product priorities, and sales plays.

Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in B2B SaaS or enterprise software sales, including 7+ years in sales leadership and experience managing managers.
  • Proven success scaling EMEA go-to-market strategy and sales organizations in high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience leading Enterprise and Corporate, Mid-Market, or other high-velocity sales motions.
  • Track record of delivering new business and expansion through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Experience selling technical products to engineering, product, IT, and executive buyers; developer tools or infrastructure experience is a plus.
  • Expertise in pipeline generation, forecasting, territory planning, account coverage, sales methodology, and performance management.

jobs.title: Group Financial Accountant
jobs.description_text:
About hyperexponential (hx)
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
About the team
Finance at hx is a lean, AI-native team that builds the operational engine behind a high-growth, fast-moving business. The team's job is to turn complexity into clarity: giving leaders accurate numbers, clean controls, and the confidence to make bold decisions quickly. It is not a back-office function; it is close to the action, involved early in decisions, and expected to shape how the business scales.
The team is still building its foundations, which means there is genuine scope to define how processes work, not just execute them. Everyone on the team is relatively new to their role, and that is by design. hx is growing quickly, and the Finance function is scaling to match. What that means in practice is that the people who join now have the opportunity to build things from scratch, automate what should not be done by hand, and become a cornerstone of how the company operates for years to come.
This role sits at the heart of day-to-day finance operations: revenue, VAT, payroll, banking, and month-end close. The work is precise, deadline-driven, and consequential. If you find satisfaction in owning a process properly, keeping it clean, and making it better over time, this is the environment where that instinct will be rewarded.
Check out our 
Finance Candidate Hub
 for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!
What you'll be doing
Own the end-to-end revenue and accounts receivable cycle in NetSuite, ensuring sales orders are raised promptly, invoices reflect the correct FRS102 revenue recognition treatment, and the AR ledger is reconciled monthly with no unexplained misstatements at year-end audit.
Drive the month-end close to a defined timetable, completing the close by working day four and ensuring all balance sheet reconciliations are evidenced and reviewed by working day seven.
Manage UK VAT compliance from preparation through to filing, maintaining audit-ready workpapers at all times and ensuring every return is reconciled, accurate, and submitted on time with no penalties.
Take full ownership of UK payroll once the HiBob transition completes, processing each monthly run accurately and on schedule, and maintaining clean payroll-to-NetSuite reconciliations.

The Role
The Workplace Program Manager is responsible for leading and scaling the programs that span Legora's Workplace organization — the initiatives that help employees move faster, have a better day-to-day experience, and keep our offices running within budget as we grow into new markets. This role operates across functions and geographies, owning programs end-to-end while building the structure, processes, and tools that let the Workplace team operate consistently and at scale without slowing down.
This is a cross-functional role that requires strong program management fundamentals, independent judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. You'll work closely with the Workplace team — Managers, Coordinators, and Design/Build — to turn their vision for what a great office experience looks like into programs that are actually launched, adopted, and improving over time. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-growing environments, skilled at building clarity and alignment, and motivated by improving how the Workplace team delivers for employees globally.
If you love the moment a good idea becomes a program employees actually notice and love, this is your role.

Own and manage a portfolio of cross-functional Workplace programs with global scope, driving delivery from scoping through launch, ongoing operation, and continuous improvement
Collaborate deeply with Regional Workplace Managers and Workplace Managers to design programs, events and experiences that make employees' day-to-day faster and better — from travel to winter parties and physical security
Develop and maintain program-level processes, playbooks, and operating standards that let the Workplace team deliver consistently across regions and offices
Lead cross-functional workstreams in partnership with Real Estate, Finance, IT, and Security, ensuring Workplace priorities are clearly represented, aligned, and delivered
Identify gaps in current programs and proactively design and launch solutions, often without an established playbook
Build and scale tooling, workflows, and internal resources that improve team effectiveness and the consistency of the employee-facing experience
Own the budget for programs under your management — building the business case, tracking spend against plan, and flagging drift before it becomes a problem
Manage vendor relationships and provide direction where relevant to program delivery, ensuring alignment to Legora's standards
Help monitor and control budget across the broader Workplace portfolio, and step in to unblock global procurement and vendor issues as they come up

jobs.title: Inbound Sales Development Representative - EMEA
jobs.description_text:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for an experienced, self-directed Sales Development Representative to own the first stage of engagement across EMEA. You will manage and qualify inbound leads, event MQLs, and accounts showing meaningful engagement through our account-based programs.

This is not a purely reactive lead-response role. You will combine fast, consultative follow-up with thoughtful, proactive outreach to turn customer interest and buying signals into qualified meetings and pipeline.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the first point of contact for prospective customers across EMEA, creating a fast, thoughtful, and credible first impression.
  • Respond rapidly to high-intent inbound inquiries, including demo requests, pricing requests, trials, contact forms, and other hand-raisers.
  • Own follow-up for event leads, adapting outreach based on the person, account, and engagement history.
  • Research and proactively engage targeted accounts that show meaningful engagement
  • Convert qualified interest into sales-ready meetings and opportunities for Account Executives.
  • Execute coordinated outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely activity, qualification notes, and account context in Salesforce.
  • Partner closely with EMEA Account Executives and with Marketing, Revenue Operations, and the global SDR organization to improve lead quality, routing, messaging, and conversion.
  • Share patterns and feedback from prospects so the broader team can improve campaigns, events, content, and the customer journey.

Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of successful SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS or a similar environment. 
  • A demonstrated record of setting goals, taking ownership, and delivering measurable results.
  • Experience communicating with customers, prospects, or other external audiences.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to operate independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to engage senior and technical stakeholders.

Please note this role is a Hybrid position, requiring a minimum of 3 days in our London Office. 

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company
